companies.name: Agent Relay
companies.originalOneLiner: The infrastructure to run coding agents for your team
companies.originalDescription: Agent Relay helps software teams work better with coding agents, and helps those agents work better as a team. It gives Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and custom agents shared messaging, session history, and access to tools like GitHub, Linear, and Slack. Teams can see what every agent is doing, run checked and resumable workflows, and step in when human judgment is needed. Run it in our cloud, locally, or on your own hardware.
companies.story: 这是给软件团队管编程智能体的开发工具公司。假如你是一个工程负责人，团队里好几个人同时在用 Claude Code 和 Codex 写代码，你根本不知道哪个智能体改了哪块、跑到哪一步了，想接手也接不上。Agent Relay 给这些智能体加上共享消息、会话历史和工具权限，让它们像队友一样协作，还能在需要人判断时停下来等你确认。它来自 YC 秋季批次，团队只有两人，目前不招人，但把智能体当团队成员来管这件事，正是很多工程团队马上要面对的问题。

companies.name: Tasklet
companies.originalOneLiner: Agents that own the work
companies.originalDescription: AI chatbots can answer questions, but they can't do your work — they aren't connected to your tools, can't take actions, and stop running when you close the tab. Meanwhile, knowledge workers are still spending most of their day switching between dozens of SaaS apps, manually stitching together workflows that should be automated. Tasklet is the AI agent that actually does the work. It connects to every tool you use — via thousands of built-in integrations, any HTTP API, or MCP servers — and takes real actions on your behalf: pulling reports, updating CRMs, triaging emails, processing data, and more. When it needs a UI, it generates one on the fly. When it needs to crunch numbers or do bulk operations, it writes and runs code in a cloud sandbox. When it needs to interact with a website that doesn't have an API, it uses a real browser. And because it runs in the cloud 24/7, you can set up triggers to have it take ongoing responsibility for workflows — not just do something once, but handle it going forward. The product is deliberately simple: a chat interface where you talk to an extremely capable agent. But underneath that simplicity is a cloud-native agent runtime, best-in-class context engineering, a universal connections layer, and multi-model support that keeps us on the frontier as AI improves. We think legacy SaaS is being unbundled by agents, and Tasklet is the operating system that ties it all together.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是能真正替你干活的智能体。想象你是一个每天被各种后台系统淹没的运营人员，早上要拉报表、更新客户记录、分拣邮件，还要在十几个网页之间来回切换，关掉标签页任务就断了。Tasklet 连上你常用的工具，自己动手拉数据、改记录、处理邮件，需要界面就临时生成一个，需要算数就写代码跑，遇到没有接口的网站就用真实浏览器操作，而且它一直在云端跑着。它来自 YC 春季批次，团队八人，正在招人，说明这类替人跑腿的智能体已经走到要扩队伍的阶段。

companies.name: Revise Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Automating refurbishment of $1T in consumer electronics
companies.originalDescription: E-waste recycling facilities spend most of their time and effort sifting through discarded electronics, searching for valuable devices, refurbishing them, and reselling them in second-hand markets. Our first product is an AI-enabled robotic system that integrates with these facilities to assess and refurbish hundreds of laptops a day without any human intervention. The system tests laptops, wipes their hard drives, photographs them, and posts them on online marketplaces for resale, regardless of model, manufacturer, or operating system.
companies.story: 这是用机器人翻新消费电子产品的公司。一个电子垃圾回收厂的仓库主管，每天面对成堆的旧笔记本，要一台台挑出还能用的，测试、擦硬盘、拍照、再挂到二手平台卖，人手根本忙不过来。Revise Robotics 做的机器人系统能接进这类工厂，每天自动评估和翻新几百台笔记本，不管什么品牌、什么系统都能处理。它来自 YC 冬季批次，团队三人，正在招人，而它盯上的是一万亿美元规模的电子产品翻新市场，把人工分拣变成自动化流水线，值得关注。

companies.name: Vendo
companies.originalOneLiner: Let your users build their own features on top of your product
companies.originalDescription: Vendo is the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps directly on top of your product. Rather than waiting on an ever-growing feature backlog, your users can personalize the product to exactly how they work, create their own automations, and integrate hundreds of external tools, all without your team writing a line of code. Everything runs on your existing API, renders natively in your own theme and components, and executes inside secure sandboxes within your existing security guardrails, so your source code is never touched. Companies can plug Vendo into an agent they already have, or deploy a production-ready agent complete with the ability to take actions in the product, generate UI, and draw on a built-in knowledge base. Vendo is open source and installs with a single command, and we work closely with teams to get it running for their product.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是软件产品的定制化层。如果你是一个 SaaS 产品的客户成功负责人，客户天天提各种小需求，功能排期越堆越长，工程团队根本做不完。Vendo 让你的用户直接在你的产品上搭自己的小功能和微应用，不用你写一行代码，全部跑在你现有的接口上，用你自己的主题和组件渲染，还在你原有的安全边界里执行，源码不会被碰。它来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，目前不招人，而且是开源的，一条命令就能装，这种把定制权交给用户的做法，对产品团队来说是个值得留意的方向。

companies.name: TovenAI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents for compliance at institutional trading firms
companies.originalDescription: TovenAI builds a platform of AI agents that handle manual, data-intensive work for compliance teams at institutional trading firms, with six agents currently live. Our customers range from specialist firms to large global institutions, with our agents supporting multiple compliance workflows at a top-10 institutional brokerage. With prebuilt connectors to more than 30 systems—including Bloomberg, Cloud9, and NICE Actimize—firms can onboard to our platform and evaluate results using their own data in less than a week.
companies.story: 这是给机构交易公司做合规自动化的公司。一个合规分析师每天要处理大量手工且数据密集的核查工作，规则多、系统杂，稍有疏漏就麻烦。TovenAI 用一组智能体接手这些活，目前已有六个智能体上线，客户从专业机构到大型全球机构都有，其中一家排名前十的机构券商在用它的智能体支持多个合规流程。它预接了三十多个系统，包括彭博、Cloud9 和 NICE Actimize，公司一周内就能用自己的数据上手评估。它来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，目前不招人，但合规这块苦活被智能体接手的趋势很清楚。

companies.name: Micora
companies.originalOneLiner: Microgrids in a box built anywhere in days
companies.originalDescription: Micora builds a solar-farm-in-a-box that can be shipped anywhere and built without specialized labor. We have designed a new type of solar farm micorgrid that is palletized, lightweight, and deployable. Our system autonomously builds 100kWp of capacity per day and is easily scalable to MWs of capacity which is a size currently only serviced by slow moving and at capacity EPCs. As demand from data centers, advanced manufacturing, and electrification strains existing power infrastructure, the ability to deploy substantial generation quickly is becoming increasingly valuable and unavailable. We are the only company that services utility-scale power needs in weeks.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是能装箱运走的微型电网。如果你是一个数据中心的设施负责人，电不够用，等传统工程队排期要很久，扩容计划只能往后拖。Micora 把太阳能农场做成托盘化、轻量的箱式系统，运到任何地方都不需要专门工种，系统每天能自动搭出十万瓦峰值容量，还能轻松扩到兆瓦级，而这一规模过去只有动作慢、产能满的工程承包商才接。它来自 YC 秋季批次，团队三人，目前不招人，在数据中心和制造业用电越来越紧的当下，几周内就能部署大容量发电这件事本身就很值得看。

companies.name: Ruma Care
companies.originalOneLiner: The operations stack for biologic infusion clinics
companies.originalDescription: Ruma Care automates all admin work for infusion clinics - starting with prior authorizations & copay assistance enrollment. Biologics are expensive medications that cost $80-$150K+ per year per patient, and often need to be administered in specific settings called infusion clinics. Medical providers buy these drugs up front to secure pricing deals and safer inventory - they are reimbursed for the cost of the medications through the patients’ insurance. Current medical workflows aren't built for infusion clinics. Inventory, storage, transport, and billing is still managed through paper and excel spreadsheets. And because they’re so expensive, these specialty medications are denied by insurers at a rate of 37% each year. When they are denied, when workflows fail, or patients are infused before paperwork is cleared, providers don’t get reimbursed for the medication and are left covering the costs. Ruma Care solves this so clinics get paid, patients get treated faster, and care teams spend less time fighting forms. We do this in three ways: 1. For each medication, diagnosis, and insurance combination, Ruma extracts the submission criteria required to get the drug approved by insurers. 2. We pull out the correct forms, then automate the form-filling for prior authorizations. 3. Lastly, we enroll patients in copay assistance programs, all in one workflow and platform. We turn a process that traditionally spans 70+ online portals, disparate paper forms, and manual phone calling into a single, streamlined platform. As we process prior authorizations, our models learn from denial patterns to understand exactly what insurers need to see to get a prior authorization approved.
companies.story: 这是给生物制剂输注诊所做后台运营的公司。一个诊所运营负责人每天最头疼的是保险预授权和共付援助登记，生物制剂一年一个病人要八万到十五万美元以上，保险拒赔率高达百分之三十七，一旦流程没走完就给病人输注，药费就得诊所自己扛。Ruma Care 把这些行政工作自动化，从预授权开始，帮诊所把库存、存储、运输和账单从纸和表格里解放出来。它来自 YC 冬季批次，团队五人，正在招人，这类高值药物的运营痛点很具体，值得关注。

companies.name: ProvenMetal
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native electronics manufacturing for the American industrial base
companies.originalDescription: ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States. Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet. We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.
companies.story: 这是做美国本土电子制造的公司。一个硬件工程负责人最怕的就是电路板打样，国内工厂又慢又贵，想回流美国，供应链却还没跟上，一等就是好几周。ProvenMetal 把零件采购、可制造性审查和组装这些瓶颈自动化，几天就能交付电路板，而不是几周。它来自 YC 夏季批次，团队四人，正在招人，在美国制造业回流的大背景下，把最快的电路板制造留在本土，这个方向值得留意。

companies.name: Hubble
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native retrieval engine for medical records
companies.originalDescription: Hubble is the AI-native retrieval engine for medical records, delivered in one API. I scaled Grow Therapy to a $3B valuation; my cofounder built One Medical's first AI agents, now used by millions of patients. Four weeks in, we already have ten signed customers and 7-figure year-one revenue across platform and usage fees. Every new agentic use case across industries like legal, clinical trials, consumer health, insurance, needs a complete medical record, and today that still means faxes and phone calls. Hubble fixes that with voice and browser agents that reach the providers APIs can't, in a market worth $45B just in the verticals we've mapped so far.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗记录的智能检索。如果你是一个处理人身伤害案件的律师，或者一个临床研究协调员，你需要一份完整的病历，可现实是还在发传真、打电话，接口根本够不到那些小诊所。Hubble 用一个接口交付人工智能原生的病历检索，靠语音和浏览器智能体去触达接口到不了的地方。它来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，目前不招人，但四周内已有十家签约客户和七位数首年收入，覆盖法律、临床试验、消费健康和保险等场景，这个信号说明需求真实存在。

companies.name: Gamgee
companies.originalOneLiner: Curing cancer. Starting with dogs.
companies.originalDescription: ​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. We sequence a dog’s tumour and healthy DNA, identify mutations unique to its cancer, and design a vaccine that teaches the immune system what to attack. We manage the entire process- from vet intake and tissue collection through genomic analysis, vaccine production, treatment and response monitoring ​We are now turning that one off effort into a repeatable clinical system. Gamgee is running clinical trials in Australia, working with vets, oncologists and specialised laboratories, and accepting cases globally. Our goal is to make personalised cancer treatment accessible to every dog that needs it- and use each case to improve the treatment for the next
companies.story: 这是做个性化信使核糖核酸癌症疫苗的生物科技公司，先从狗开始。想象一个宠物主人，狗做完手术、化疗和免疫治疗都没用，医生只说还剩几个月。Gamgee 的起点就是创始人保罗的狗罗西，他用人工智能和基因组分析找到肿瘤靶点，与科学家合作做出据信是首个完全由计算设计的、给狗用的信使核糖核酸癌症疫苗，治疗后多个肿瘤明显缩小。公司现在把测序、找突变、设计疫苗、生产、治疗和监测做成完整平台，来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，目前不招人，从一只狗到可复制的流程，这条路值得关注。

readings.title: Show HN: Will Jev pull the lever in the trolley problem?
readings.story: 技术社区里常有人把老问题重新拿出来玩，比如电车难题：一辆失控电车冲向五个人，你手边有个拉杆，拉一下车会转向另一条轨道，但那边有一个人。这次有人把它做成了网页小项目，还让一个叫 Jev 的角色来决定拉不拉。这类东西为什么值得看？因为它表面是道德困境，背后其实是人在设计一个自动判断的规则，而写代码的人每天都在做类似的事：把模糊的取舍变成明确的逻辑。读的时候可以留意作者怎么把抽象问题拆成可操作的选项，以及他有没有在互动里藏进自己的判断。你也可以问，如果换成你来写这段规则，你会怎么设定条件。

readings.title: Flock reportedly tries to shrink workforce with employee buyouts
readings.story: 一家公司开始用买断的方式让员工主动离开，通常说明它正在调整规模，或者对接下来要投入的方向有了新的打算。对普通团队来说，这种消息往往不是突然出现的，而是前面已经有过招聘放缓、预算收紧或者业务重心转移的迹象。这篇报道值得读，是因为它把一家具体公司在压力下的选择摆了出来，而不只是讲一个行业趋势。读的时候可以注意它提到的人数、条件和时间点，看公司是怎么把调整包装成自愿选择，也想想同样的情况下，管理者和员工各自会怎么算这笔账。

readings.title: 🧠 Community Wisdom: Finding your first users before the product exists, debriefing your own interviews, what to optimize for in the early years of your career, and more
readings.story: 很多做产品的人都有过这样的时刻：脑子里有个想法，但手里还没有能给人看的东西，却已经急着想知道谁会愿意用。这期社区问答把这类早期困惑摆在一起，包括产品还没成形时怎么找到第一批用户、做完用户访谈后怎么自己复盘、以及职业头几年到底该把精力放在哪里。它值得读，是因为这些问题来自真实的人，答案也往往带着各自的处境，而不是一套通用公式。读的时候可以挑一个和你当下最接近的问题，看回答的人是怎么判断优先级、怎么处理信息不足的。

companies.name: Locke
companies.originalOneLiner: Locke powers agentic government work.
companies.originalDescription: Locke builds AI agents that help companies and governments work together. Our agents power Locke Government Affairs, the first AI-native government affairs firm, and are being deployed to government agencies across America. Every consequential American company in the 21st century will need to work with the government: AI labs, data centers, healthcare, defense, robotics, the list goes on. Locke is building the AI infrastructure to power the next era of public-private collaboration. Locke's team comes from The White House, Deloitte, the US Congress, and the Pentagon.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是政府事务与公共部门协作的智能体方向。假如你是一家大型人工智能实验室的政府事务负责人，今天要同时盯三份不同州的新规征求意见稿，还要准备下周与联邦机构的闭门沟通材料，手头的表格和邮件已经乱成一团。Locke 做的事情就是让智能体接手这类政府事务工作，把企业与政府之间的沟通、材料准备和流程跟进自动化。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队目前只有两个人，并且正在招聘。值得关注的地方在于，它的团队背景来自白宫、德勤、美国国会和五角大楼，同时它已经在向美国政府机构部署，这说明它切入的不是普通的企业软件，而是门槛很高的公共部门场景。

companies.name: Floracene
companies.originalOneLiner: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed
companies.originalDescription: Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team. The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first customer had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production. A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption. Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗行业内部工具的无代码部署。想象你是一家诊所的运营负责人，前台同事自己用一下午拼出了一个预约看板，看着挺好用，但它只能躺在那台电脑上，因为谁也不敢把一个会碰到患者隐私数据的工具随便发给大家用。Floracene 让不会写代码的医疗运营人员用自然语言描述自己需要的工具，然后一键部署，并且连接到真实业务数据，读写权限按用户划分。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两个人，目前不招聘。值得看的是它解决的是一个非常具体的卡点：医疗行业里工具不缺，缺的是能安全上线、能共享、能连生产数据的部署方式，它的第一个客户就同时有好几个员工各自做了本地工具却没法共用。

companies.name: Replicas
companies.originalOneLiner: Run any coding agent harness in the cloud
companies.originalDescription: Replicas is a cloud coding agent that allows you to delegate tasks to Claude Code or Codex from the app, Slack, Linear, and more. Each task works inside of a sandboxed virtual machine, allowing teams to heavily parallelize work and burn through tickets. Replicas agents output higher quality PRs via feedback loops - each task automatically is notified and fixes CI failures and reads all code reviews. With Environments, engineering teams can configure agents to run their entire codebase locally, verify its work, and provide preview URLs.
companies.story: 这是做云端编程智能体基础设施的公司。如果你是一个工程负责人，手上排着一长串待修的问题单，团队里每个人都在用 Claude Code 或 Codex，但任务只能在各自电脑上跑，没法真正并行，进度就卡在那里。Replicas 让你从应用、Slack、Linear 等地方把任务派给云端智能体，每个任务跑在独立的沙箱虚拟机里，团队可以大规模并行处理工单。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两个人，正在招聘。值得关注的是它不只让智能体写代码，还通过反馈回路自动处理持续集成失败、读取代码评审意见，并且可以用环境配置让智能体在完整代码库里运行和验证，这对想真正把智能体用进日常开发流程的工程团队来说，是一个更接近生产环境的思路。

companies.name: Multiplier
companies.originalOneLiner: Agent harnesses for asset managers
companies.originalDescription: Multiplier helps institutional investors research stocks and manage their portfolios. We're live with six hedge funds, and our users spend 4+ hours a day in the platform. Investors who try "nearly every tool on the market," to quote a client of ours, "wind up with an unwieldy collection of fragmented point solutions." Those who focus on building a great setup with general agents are instead "signing up for a full-time job." So we deploy a platform called Multiplier that unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI work, human work, and tacit firm knowledge in one secure, governed, customized application. Our first vertical: independent equity funds with $250M-$5B of assets. They know AI is essential for staying relevant, but they don't have the time or talent to figure out what to do about it. But once we deploy Multiplier––"We used to spend 80% of our time gathering information and 20% of our time acting on it," said one customer. "Multiplier has flipped those percentages."
companies.story: 这家公司做的是给资产管理机构用的智能体工作平台。一个股票研究员每天要在各种终端、表格和内部笔记之间来回切换，收集信息就占掉大部分时间，真正用来形成判断的时间反而很少。Multiplier 把结构化数据、非结构化数据、人工智能工作、人工工作和机构内部的隐性知识统一到一个安全可控的应用里，帮投资团队做研究和组合管理。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三个人，正在招聘，目前已经有六家对冲基金在使用，用户每天在平台上花四个小时以上。值得看的是它选择的第一批客户是管理规模在 2.5 亿到 50 亿美元之间的独立股票基金，这类机构知道人工智能重要，却没有时间和人手自己摸索，而 Multiplier 直接把这个缺口当成产品来填。

companies.name: Taiga
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous medical billing
companies.originalDescription: Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork. We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them. We want providers to treat patients while we handle the rest.
companies.story: 这是做医疗账单自动化的公司。假如你是一家小诊所的医生，白天看完病人，晚上还要对着就诊记录琢磨该用哪个计费代码，报上去之后又可能被保险公司打回来，钱迟迟收不到。Taiga 让医生上传就诊数据，由人工智能判断正确的计费代码，检查理赔申请有没有错误，再提交给保险公司，并且处理被拒的理赔。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两个人，正在招聘。值得看的是两位创始人从小是朋友，他们的父母都经营自己的诊所，账单问题一直是家里的压力和收入流失来源，所以他们想做的事情很明确：让医生专心看病，剩下的交给系统。

companies.name: Insurf
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI-Native Decision Layer for Health Insurance
companies.originalDescription: Insurf is the AI-native data and decision layer for health insurance. Our model Surely identifies the lowest-cost coverage for anyone, saving individuals, families, and companies thousands per employee. Our product Inveto collects the data from hospitals and clinics that informs Surely.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是健康保险的数据与决策层。如果你负责一家公司的员工福利，每年续保时都要在几份看起来差不多的保险方案里做选择，却很难说清哪一份对员工和公司真正划算。Insurf 用模型 Surely 找出对个人、家庭和企业成本最低的保险覆盖方案，另一款产品 Inveto 则负责从医院和诊所收集支撑这些判断的数据。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三个人，目前不招聘。值得关注的是它把数据收集和决策放在同一个闭环里，而不是只做一个比价工具，这在健康保险这种信息高度分散的领域里，是一个更完整的切入点。

companies.name: Kimpton
companies.location: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
companies.originalOneLiner: Live Evaluation Arenas for Financial Work
companies.originalDescription: In investment management, every decision gets graded. The market prints the answer on a date known in advance, and nobody gets to argue with it. Kimpton is financial AI that answers to reality. Kimpton OS is the AI-native operating system for investment teams: it does the research and hands PMs structured trades. EarningsBench is a public benchmark where models forecast quarterly earnings before companies report and the reported numbers do the scoring. Koliseum is the set of point-in-time financial environments we build from that work, for labs to train and evaluate models on. The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding into passive. AI was supposed to fix that, but it hasn't. Funds either stitch together a dozen point tools or babysit general agents all day, and neither gets them to the trade. Kimpton OS goes straight to it. It ingests a fund's mandate, strategy, and positions, connects to the institutional data the fund already runs on, and returns a structured trade proposal built for that fund. It's built to disagree, because consensus is poison for investment decisions. Instead of telling a PM what they want to hear, it surfaces the breaches and risks they'd otherwise miss. That same work is how we grade AI. Static benchmarks leak into training data. Simulations reward what their authors imagined. A forecast sealed before the outcome exists and scored when the company reports can't be rehearsed or backdated. We started in markets because they're the one place reality answers on schedule. We're two ex-Goldman engineers and an ex-SpaceX engineer. We left to start our own quantitative systematic hedge fund, raised $10M from a family office at 21 and 22, and scaled it to $35M over four years. We learned to trust live results over historical fit. We built Kimpton inside that fund, then productized the stack. We're live with our first institutional client, a $3.3B manager. Our first market is fundamental equity funds from $1B to $10B, and the labs that need to know whether their models can do this work.
companies.story: 这是做投资管理领域人工智能评估与操作系统的公司。一个投资组合经理每天面对的是研究材料、模型输出和交易想法，但真正难的是判断哪个判断靠谱，因为市场会在某个已知日期给出答案，谁也争不过。Kimpton 的 Kimpton OS 面向投资团队，做研究并把结构化的交易建议交给投资经理，EarningsBench 是一个公开基准，让模型在公司发布财报前预测季度盈利，再用实际公布的数字打分，Koliseum 则是从这些工作中积累的时点金融环境，供实验室训练和评估模型。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队五个人，目前不招聘。值得看的是它把评估这件事做成了公开基准，让模型的表现有一个由现实来判分的标准，而不是只靠演示。

companies.name: DeepAware AI (Robotics Center of Silicon Valley)
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots, parts & RL envs & evals - delivered in 48 hrs / pickup in SF.
companies.originalDescription: DeepAware (Robotics Center of Silicon Valley, https://roboticscenter.ai/) is the fastest way for enterprises and researchers to get robots and robotics parts in the US — 72-hour delivery or Bay Area pickup. Beyond hardware, we help teams collect teleoperation data, build reinforcement learning environments, and deploy robots into production. Customers include AI labs, industrial operations, research teams, and event producers.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是机器人硬件、数据采集与强化学习环境的供应。如果你是一个实验室的研究员，项目下周就要开始跑实验，可订购的机械臂和零部件还在跨国物流里等着，整个进度就被拖住了。DeepAware 也叫做硅谷机器人中心，面向企业和研究团队提供机器人与机器人零部件，承诺 72 小时送达或者湾区自提，同时帮助团队采集遥操作数据、搭建强化学习环境，并把机器人部署到生产场景。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队四个人，正在招聘，客户包括人工智能实验室、工业运营团队、研究团队和活动制作方。值得关注的是它不只是卖硬件，还把数据、环境和部署这些机器人落地时最费时间的环节一起打包，这对赶进度的研究和工业团队来说很实际。

companies.name: Voltair
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous Drones for Earth Observation
companies.originalDescription: Voltair is building the world's first globally distributed network of autonomous drones for Earth observation. Power utilities are the perfect first customer. Aging infrastructure and extreme weather drive the need for millimeter-scale inspection data on the power grid. Utilities spend tens of billions of dollars every year just looking at their own equipment. Autonomous drone fleets will enable utilities to inspect 7 million miles of infrastructure more frequently, quickly, and accurately. Our long-range, weatherized flying robots work with charging pads installed directly on utility poles. Each new pad unlocks 1000 square miles of coverage. With a charging network deployed on the power grid, we can serve existing multi-billion dollar data markets in road, rail and telecom inspection at 10x lower prices while enabling entirely new applications in hyperlocal weather monitoring, forestry, construction, search & rescue, and insurance. We envision a future in which drone "instances" are requested on-demand through our platform, enabling any application builder to serve these critical markets without ever operating their own hardware.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是用于地球观测的自主无人机网络。一个电力公司的巡检主管每年要派人去看自家电网，七百万英里的线路靠人工和传统方式检查，花掉的钱数以百亿计，遇到极端天气还更难覆盖。Voltair 把长航程、耐候的无人机和直接安装在电线杆上的充电垫组合起来，让无人机机队可以更频繁、更快速、更精确地巡检基础设施，每新增一个充电垫就能解锁一千平方英里的覆盖范围。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五个人，正在招聘。值得看的是它先从电力设施巡检切入，因为这里已经有数十亿美元规模的数据需求，同时这套部署在电网上的充电网络还能以更低价格服务公路、铁路和电信巡检，并打开超本地天气监测和林业等新场景。

companies.name: Misprint
companies.originalOneLiner: Misprint is building Robinhood for Pokemon cards
companies.originalDescription: Misprint is an all-in-one marketplace that solves the biggest pain point in the collectibles world: opaque pricing. Collectors, investors, and hobbyists currently rely on scattered data from auction houses, online forums, and reseller platforms, making it difficult to know the true value of their items. Misprint streamlines the process by combining accurate pricing analytics with a seamless buy/sell marketplace, making it easier than ever to understand and monetize collectible assets. Existing marketplaces lack robust, real-time analytics because accurate valuations require deep expertise in both the collectibles domain and advanced pricing algorithms. Misprint’s unique blend of insider trading card knowledge and machine learning allows us to fill this gap. Building these pricing models requires extensive data infrastructure, deep domain expertise, and cutting-edge ML. Recent surges in the trading card market show that collectors crave transparent valuations. The global collectibles market is worth tens of billions of dollars. Eva has experienced the scale of this industry firsthand, generating $500k ARR within three months of taking her Pokemon card-selling side hustle full-time. With additional segments like sports cards, comics, and emerging collectible categories, the growth runway is immense. Co-founders Eva and Jon have been best friends since Exeter, combining finance expertise, a passion for collectibles, and mathematical rigor. By merging Goldman Sachs-level financial analytics with top-tier mathematical talent, Misprint is uniquely positioned to become the go-to platform for fair, transparent pricing in the collectibles space.
companies.story: 这是做收藏卡牌交易平台的公司。一个收藏爱好者手里有一张稀有卡，想出手却不知道到底值多少钱，因为价格散落在拍卖行、论坛和转售平台上，谁也说不准真实行情。Misprint 把定价分析和买卖市场合在一起，让收藏者、投资者和玩家更容易看懂并变现自己的藏品。它来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队四个人，正在招聘。值得关注的是收藏品市场长期缺少可靠的实时定价，而准确的估值既需要懂卡牌领域的专业知识，也需要机器学习能力，Misprint 正是把这两件事结合起来，试图解决这个行业里最让人头疼的价格不透明问题。

readings.title: Building the fastest LLMs: why we're starting with diffusion
readings.story: 如果你最近在关注大模型，大概会注意到一个反复被提起的焦虑：回答得再聪明，如果等上十几秒才出字，用户就会走。工程团队于是开始琢磨，除了堆更多显卡，还有没有别的路。这条讨论之所以值得看，是因为它把话题从模型能力挪到了速度本身，而速度往往决定一个产品能不能被日常使用。读的时候可以留意作者怎么解释扩散模型和常见生成方式的差别，以及他为什么认为这条路线在速度上更有机会。重点看他如何拆解延迟来自哪里，又做了哪些取舍。

readings.title: Join the WIRED World Fair in Miami on November 4
readings.story: 做产品的人大概都有过这种时刻：一个行业忽然变得热闹，会议一场接一场，人人都在谈机会，可回到自己的项目里，却说不清这波热度到底和自己有什么关系。WIRED 办这场迈阿密的线下活动，背后其实也是这种气氛的产物：当一项技术从实验室走到商业舞台，人们需要面对面交换判断，而不只是隔着屏幕看新闻。这篇值得读的地方在于，它提供了一个观察窗口，让人看到媒体如何组织一场关于技术和基础设施的对话。读的时候可以留意它把哪些话题放在台前，又请了什么样的人来谈，这些选择本身就在透露行业当下最在意什么。

readings.title: [AINews] Here are 6 Clones of Jev in 2 days
readings.story: 如果你最近在关注 人工智能 圈子，可能会注意到一个奇怪的现象：某个人的做法刚被讨论，两天之内就冒出好几个几乎一样的复制品。做工具、做内容、做产品的人都会遇到这种时刻，一个想法被验证后，模仿者来得比想象中快得多。这篇来自 Latent Space 的文章正是从这种复制速度切入，值得读是因为它把注意力放在了一个容易被忽略的问题上：当克隆变得如此便宜，原创者真正剩下的是什么。读的时候不妨看作者怎么数这些克隆、怎么判断它们之间的差别，以及他如何区分哪些是简单照搬，哪些在原有基础上做了自己的取舍。

companies.name: Mount
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI Agent Insurance Carrier
companies.originalDescription: TLDR: Mount is building the AI insurance carrier, starting with liability coverage for deployed AI agents. As everyone moves AI Agents into production and gives them more responsibility, we help businesses insure and secure them. Whenever responsibility shifts from human operators to autonomous systems, so too does the liability that accompanies it. The systems also introduce new risks: agentic software failures, prompt injection attacks, autonomous workflow errors, data leaks, and more. Legacy insurance was not built for this. Existing policies are often silent, ambiguous, or exclude autonomous software, and traditional insurers lack the data and technical capability to assess deployed AI Systems. Our first product, the Mount AI Liability Policy, is built for mid-market and enterprise companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. We scan and red-team AI deployments, quantify operational risk, help fix vulnerabilities, and insure the residual risk with purpose-built AI liability coverage. Mount is best thought of as a highly automated version of today's commercial insurance carriers, which run on manual workflows, layers of intermediaries, and tens of thousands of employees. AI enables automation of underwriting, pricing, policy issuance, claims, fraud detection, customer support, and distribution. We believe that the best way to use this opportunity is to rebuild those processes from the ground up.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能责任保险的公司。假如你是一家企业的运营负责人，最近刚把一批智能体放进真实业务流程里，让它们自动处理客户请求、调取数据、甚至代表公司对外沟通，这时候你可能会突然意识到一个问题：如果智能体出了错，比如被提示注入攻击、工作流跑偏、泄露了数据，责任算谁的？传统保单往往对自主软件含糊其辞，甚至直接排除在外，保险公司也缺乏评估这类系统的数据和能力。Mount 想做的就是为部署智能体的中大型企业提供专门的责任险，先扫描并红队测试企业的智能体部署，再据此承保。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，切的是一个随着智能体普及而必然膨胀的新风险市场。

companies.name: Cyberdesk
companies.originalOneLiner: Self learning computer use agent for developers
companies.originalDescription: Cyberdesk is the first self learning computer use agent for developers to automate desktop workflows. For example, one of our customers is building an AI agent for hospital patient intake, and they’re using us to automate an entire team of people manually clicking and typing into a desktop app to book appointments. We launched mid July, and our agent is already operating in production environments, creating appointments in electronic health record apps and processing files in legacy ERPs. We’ve built the first computer use agent that memorizes tasks and repeats them quickly while still adapting to unexpected changes on the screen. A good analogy is to how humans use computers: once we get used to an app, we use it much faster, while still adapting to random popups and crashes. This new paradigm for computer use will be needed by every company automating human workflows on computers. Mahmoud previously built robotic process automation solutions impacting 20K+ employees at a Fortune 100 company. He also built AI & ML solutions at Baylor College of Medicine Neuroscience & Texas Children's Hospital + co-published a paper at the Rice Networks Group. Alan is ex-NASA and previously dropped out to be the first founding engineer at a PearX startup. He is a second time founder, having previously built and scaled a consumer AI app to thousands of paying users. Computer-use agents will automate the $6T dollars spent on enterprise knowledge work and Cyberdesk will be the platform to power this. We’d love to talk with you! https://cal.com/mahmoud-al-madi-klrs5s/30min
companies.story: 这是给开发者用的电脑操作智能体。想象你负责一家医院的病人登记流程，团队里有人每天的工作就是在老旧的桌面软件里反复点击、输入，帮病人预约挂号，软件界面一变就得重新摸索。Cyberdesk 做的事情，是让智能体记住这些操作步骤，之后快速重复执行，同时还能应对屏幕上突然弹出的窗口或崩溃。它已经在中七月上线，并在真实生产环境里运行，比如在电子健康记录软件里创建预约、在老旧的企业管理系统里处理文件。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队两人，值得关注的地方在于它不只是演示，而是已经在处理那些没人愿意手动重复的脏活。

companies.name: Fabraix
companies.originalOneLiner: The world's frontier hacker of AI agents.
companies.originalDescription: Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies. On AgentHarm, the leading benchmark for offensive AI security, Nyx achieved a 78% attack success rate, compared with 67% for GPT-5.6 Sol. AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. And AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes. We built Nyx to automate the work required to red-team AI agents. It is multi modal by design and interacts with the target indirectly through controlled replicas of SaaS products and websites that we maintain, placing malicious payloads in webpages, documents, files, messages, and tool outputs to test how an agent behaves under different conditions. Nyx often finds its first vulnerability within minutes or hours rather than days or weeks. Because the work is fully automated, companies can repeat the test with every change and at a much lower cost than what a 7-figure red-teaming (and point-in-time) engagement would require. We're also the team behind ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a benchmark that measures AI security in terms of how much it costs attackers to break an AI system; providing a game-theoretic framework to understand how motivated a rational attacker would be in exploiting the system.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是人工智能安全里的红队方向。如果你负责一家公司的智能体安全，你会发现麻烦在于智能体变得比团队测试它的速度还快：换个模型、改个提示、加个工具或权限，行为就可能完全不同，哪怕应用代码没动。Fabraix 做的 Nyx 就是自动化的红队智能体，持续寻找面向客户的智能体里的漏洞。它已经在美国财富五百强公司的智能体里发现过漏洞，在 AgentHarm 这个进攻性人工智能安全基准上取得百分之七十八的攻击成功率，对比 GPT 5.6 Sol 的百分之六十七。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，关注点是它把红队工作从人工变成持续自动运行。

companies.name: BeeSafe AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Frontier AI Defenses for Social Engineering Attacks
companies.originalDescription: BeeSafe AI is building the frontier model layer for social engineering defense. Cyberattacks have moved from code to conversation: attackers now use AI to carry out long-term, trust-based manipulation across SMS, voice, email, and social platforms, often inside encrypted channels where defenders cannot see, detect, or stop them. BeeSafe changes that by deploying undercover AI agents that engage attackers directly, expose hidden infrastructure, and convert live adversarial conversations into actionable intelligence. Each engagement adds to BeeSafe's proprietary dataset of real attacker behavior and trains foundational models that continually learn about counter-persuasion, deception, and manipulation in the wild. BeeSafe is starting in financial crime, where banks already value our data against Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud and money laundering, but the opportunity is far broader. The same data and models that uncover mule networks today can protect consumers, secure enterprises, and strengthen governments against the next generation of AI-powered social engineering attacks tomorrow.
companies.story: 这是做社会工程攻击防御的公司。一个银行的反欺诈分析师每天可能面对这样的局面：客户被冒充亲友或客服的人通过短信、电话、邮件长期哄骗，最后自己授权转出钱款，而攻击往往发生在加密通道里，防守方看不见也拦不住。BeeSafe AI 部署的是卧底式智能体，直接和攻击者对话，暴露背后的基础设施，把真实的对抗对话变成可用的情报，每一次交手都沉淀进它自己的攻击者行为数据集，用来训练反说服、反欺骗的基础模型。它先从金融犯罪切入，银行已经在用它的数据对抗授权推送支付欺诈和洗钱。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队三人，值得看的是它把防御从被动拦截变成主动接触。

companies.name: Origami Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Manipulate Anything Robot
companies.originalDescription: We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. We designed a hand-based data-collection device and a high DOF, direct drive robotic hand that match each other exactly, enabling us to eliminate embodiment gap and collect real-world data and deploy it directly. We want to scale real world manipulation data by deploying our devices "in the wild" like manufacturing factories, logistic centers to collect Tesla like data, use these data to train our model and then provide automation solutions to these industries.
companies.story: 这是做通用操作机器人的公司。设想一个物流中心的主管，每天要面对大量形状、重量、材质各不相同的包裹和零件，现有的机械臂往往只能处理固定几种，换个物件就得重新调试。Origami Robotics 想解决的是这个泛化难题：它同时做手部数据采集设备和自由度很高、直接驱动的机械手，两者尺寸完全对应，从而消除真实手和机器人手之间的差距，让采集到的真实世界数据能直接用于部署。它计划把这些设备放到工厂、物流中心等真实场景里持续收集数据，用来训练模型，再反过来为这些行业提供自动化方案。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，把数据、硬件和模型绑在一起是它值得关注的地方。

companies.name: HERA
companies.originalOneLiner: We make sure every factory in the world builds without mistakes.
companies.originalDescription: At Hera, we build tools that help heavy engineering teams bring products to market up to 20× faster. Today, we work with manufacturers of data center ancillary equipment, renewable energy systems, robotics, heat exchangers, power plants and pressure vessels.
companies.story: 这是做重型工程制造设计工具的公司。假如你是一家换热器或压力容器工厂的工程负责人，每天要处理复杂的图纸、零件清单和制造要求，一个尺寸或材料写错，到了车间就是返工、报废和延期。HERA 想帮这类重型工程团队把产品推向市场的速度提升最多二十倍，目前服务的客户包括数据中心配套设备、可再生能源系统、机器人、换热器、电厂和压力容器的制造商。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，并且正在招聘，切入的是制造业里容错率极低、又高度依赖人工核对的环节。

companies.name: Edgerun
companies.originalOneLiner: Military exoskeletons
companies.originalDescription: Edgerun builds military exoskeletons. The first product is a 10-pound hip system that fits over existing kit and doubles a soldier’s range. Since April 2026, Edgerun built over a dozen iterations of their product through continuous field tests with Ukrainian fighters and secured $150M+ in LOIs. Founder David Venegas previously co-founded Durin (autonomous mining robotics) and worked at Stoke Space (at 19) and Hadrian. He is a high-school dropout, state-championship runner, adventure athlete, and pilot. Edgerun is a Y Combinator company backed by General H.R. McMaster, Cyan Banister, Joshua Steinman and Jason Miller. edgerun.com
companies.story: 这是做军用外骨骼的公司。想象一名士兵背着沉重的装备在野外行军，体力消耗极快，能走多远往往决定任务能不能完成。Edgerun 的第一款产品是一个约十磅重的髋部系统，可以套在现有装备外面，把士兵的行进距离翻倍。它不是手机应用，而是把助力能力放进穿戴设备本身，直接作用在人的髋部和步态上。自二零二六年四月以来，团队已经通过和乌克兰战士的持续实地测试做出十几轮迭代，并拿到超过一点五亿美元的意向书。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队五人，硬件在真实战场环境里反复打磨是它值得关注的地方。

companies.name: Allowance
companies.originalOneLiner: The spend control layer for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: Allowance lets AI agents make purchases on a user’s behalf without ever exposing your real card number. Users approve purchases directly from their iPhone with customizable controls like spending limits, merchant restrictions, and expiration windows. Once approved, Allowance generates scoped, one-time payment credentials designed specifically for that transaction. This enables AI agents to safely complete tasks like shopping, ordering food, booking reservations, or purchasing tickets while keeping humans in control of every payment.
companies.story: 这是给智能体做支付控制的公司。如果你让智能体帮你买东西、订餐、订票，最让你犹豫的往往是它会不会乱花钱，或者把你的真实卡号暴露出去。Allowance 的做法是让智能体代替你下单，但永远不碰你的真实卡号：你在 iPhone 上直接批准这笔消费，还能设置额度上限、限定商户、设定有效期，批准之后它才生成一张只针对这笔交易、一次性的支付凭证。这样智能体可以安全地完成购物、订餐、订座、买票这些任务，而每一笔付款的决定权仍然在人手里。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队一人，切的是智能体真正开始花钱之后必然出现的控制需求。

companies.name: Archer
companies.originalOneLiner: Global payouts for the workforce powering AI
companies.originalDescription: Archer is the financial infrastructure for the AI data economy. We’re building global payouts, stablecoin banking, and yield infrastructure for the companies supplying data to frontier AI labs. As demand for high-quality data grows, millions of contributors around the world are generating, labeling, validating, and improving the datasets that power modern AI systems. Yet the financial infrastructure behind these platforms remains slow, fragmented, and expensive. Archer enables data marketplaces, AI labor platforms, and reinforcement learning environment providers to onboard workers globally, pay contributors instantly, and earn yield on idle balances. Today, companies use Archer to manage contributor earnings, global payouts, and treasury operations across hundreds of countries and payment corridors. We believe the next generation of AI companies will need purpose-built financial infrastructure. Just as cloud providers became the backbone of software, Archer is building the financial layer for the global workforce powering artificial intelligence.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能数据经济金融基础设施的公司。一个为前沿人工智能实验室提供数据的平台运营者，可能同时在几十个国家招募标注和验证人员，最头疼的是发钱：跨境转账慢、手续费高、渠道分散，闲置资金也躺在账上不生息。Archer 提供全球付款、稳定币银行和收益基础设施，让数据交易市场、人工智能用工平台和强化学习环境提供方能够全球招募贡献者、即时付款，并让闲置余额产生收益。今天已经有公司用它管理贡献者收入、全球付款和资金运营，覆盖数百个国家和支付通道。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人，关注点是它押注人工智能数据供应链会催生专门的金融层。

companies.name: Voquill
companies.originalOneLiner: The agentic OS for medical labs
companies.originalDescription: Voquill is the modern AI-native operating system for medical labs. This software manages the entire workflow of the lab (accessioning, workflow, reporting, coding, compliance, and revenue) and contains modern agentic AI tools to help each step. For example, pathologists can write reports 20% faster through our voice AI coworker. Incumbent lab operating systems are old, don't scale with how modern labs work, and can’t integrate existing AI solutions. As a result, labs are either building their own or paying millions for band-aid solutions and consultants. We're building an agentic platform to manage every aspect of the lab and displace the billions spent on legacy management systems.
companies.story: 这是做医学实验室操作系统的公司。假如你是一名病理学家，每天要写大量报告，还要在样本接收、流程流转、编码、合规和收入结算之间来回切换，用的却是几十年前设计、难以扩展、也接不上现成人工智能工具的老系统。Voquill 想做的是面向医学实验室的人工智能原生操作系统，把样本接收、工作流、报告、编码、合规和收入这一整条链路管起来，并在每一步嵌入智能体工具，比如让病理学家借助语音人工智能同事把写报告的速度提升两成。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，切入的是实验室要么自建、要么花数百万买补丁方案和咨询的老问题。

readings.title: 14 years as an engineer, written for people starting with a gap in their record
readings.story: 很多人第一次认真想自己的职业时，手里并不是一份漂亮的连续履历。中间可能空了两三年，去照顾家人、生病、换城市，或者只是没找到方向。等技术面试一轮轮过去，那个空档就会变成别人反复追问的地方，也变成自己心里过不去的坎。这篇文章值得读，是因为作者做了十四年工程师，专门写给履历有断档的人，而不是写给一路顺风顺水的人。读的时候可以留意他怎么把那段空白讲清楚：哪些地方他选择诚实交代，哪些地方他选择用后来的作品说话，以及他在面试和谈薪时怎么判断什么该坚持、什么可以让步。

readings.title: Could AI really kill us all? Your questions, answered.
readings.story: 每隔一段时间，关于人工智能会不会毁掉人类的说法就会重新热一次。有人拿它当科幻，有人拿它当营销，也有人真的在夜里睡不着。普通人面对这种话题，往往不知道该信谁：专家之间说法互相矛盾，新闻标题又只截最吓人的那一句。这篇文章来自 MIT Technology Review，形式是回答读者的问题，所以它更像一场把常见疑问摆到桌面上的对话。读的时候不必急着接受结论，可以看作者怎么区分不同层级的风险，怎么把遥远的担忧拉回到今天能观察到的技术现实，以及他在哪些问题上坦率承认还没有答案。

readings.title: What 25,000 Startup Applications Reveal About The New Rules Of Seed-Stage Startups
readings.story: 做早期投资的人每年要看大量申请，创始人则常常在同一个问题上反复碰壁：现在拿种子轮，到底什么才算够好。过去几年的规则好像一直在变，融资节奏、产品形态、增长方式都在动，很多团队拿着上一轮的经验去谈，结果发现对方关心的问题已经不一样了。这篇文章的价值在于它没有只讲一两个故事，而是从两万五千份申请里去找规律，样本大到能看出趋势。读的时候可以注意作者怎么定义这些新规则，他提到的变化是发生在融资端还是产品端，以及哪一类团队因此更容易被看见、哪一类反而更难。

companies.name: DeepReach Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Network for Physical AI Data Business
companies.originalDescription: Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse, real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every day, can produce data this authentic and valuable. DeepReach builds the network that reaches them. We design and manufacture wearable stereo capture devices, then place them with local data partners who run collection as their own business — in warehouses, workshops, farms, kitchens and repair shops. They own the local relationships; we supply the hardware, the software platform, the quality pipeline and the payments. Anyone can run a data business. That structure is what produces diversity. Instead of thousands of hours inside one environment, we deliver hours spread across thousands of environments — which is what actually makes robot policies generalize. 475 devices in the field and 100+ data partners are live across 7 countries, adding new partners every week. They've collected nearly 150,000 clips in the past three months, with volume roughly doubling month over month. Our data is in production with multiple frontier model and robotics companies, and we're scaling to 10,000+ devices across 50 countries.
companies.story: 这是给物理世界的人工智能做数据网络的公司。想象你是一位在仓库里干了多年的老师傅，每天分拣、搬运、维修，手上全是别人学不会的经验，可这些动作从来没有被完整记录下来，机器人想学也找不到素材。DeepReach 设计和制造可穿戴的立体拍摄设备，把它交到本地数据合作方手里，让他们把采集当成自己的生意来做，仓库、车间、农场、厨房、修理铺都能成为采集现场。合作方负责本地关系，公司提供硬件、软件平台、质量流程和结算。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队六人，正在用这种分散结构换取数据的多样性，而不是把上千小时都堆在同一个环境里。

companies.name: Simantic
companies.originalOneLiner: Firmware simulation for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: Simantic is modernizing the embedded firmware industry with hardware simulation developed for the adoption of AI in hardware engineering. Simantic gives both humans and AI the visibility into hardware previously limited by the physical world.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是嵌入式固件开发工具，把硬件仿真做成了给智能体用的基础设施。假如你是一位负责硬件工程的工程师，板子还没回来，固件却已经写了一大半，你只能干等实物到手才能验证，一次流片或打样的周期就能拖掉几周。Simantic 让人类和人工智能都能看到原本被物理世界挡住的那部分硬件行为，在仿真环境里提前跑起来。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，位于加拿大滑铁卢，团队四人，并且正在招聘，方向是把人工智能带进硬件工程流程。

companies.name: Rindler
companies.originalOneLiner: The IDE for Tokenmaxxers
companies.originalDescription: We build Maxxwell, a desktop app for people who run several coding agents at once. Past two or three sessions, you become the bottleneck. Every session asks you something, most of it small, and you spend the day answering instead of deciding. It is also hard to tell which sessions are making progress, which are stuck on something trivial, and which have quietly started building the wrong thing. Maxxwell puts every session in one window and marks each one working, idle, or waiting on you. On top of that sits an orchestrator, a real coding-agent session of its own that reads the others and reports back. You talk to it instead of to twelve terminals. It tells you what landed, what it decided for you, and what actually needs your call. Every worker is your own tool, unmodified. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent run in real terminal sessions you can attach to and take over at any point
companies.story: 这是给同时运行多个编程智能体的人做的开发工具。如果你是一位一天要盯十几个终端会话的开发者，很快就会发现自己成了瓶颈，每个会话都在问你问题，大多是小决定，你整天在回答而不是在判断，也分不清哪个在推进、哪个卡在琐事上、哪个已经悄悄做错了方向。Rindler 做的 Maxxwell 是一个桌面应用，把所有会话放进同一个窗口，标出每个是在工作、空闲还是等你回复，上面还有一个自己的编排会话替你读其他会话并汇报。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor Agent 都能以未修改的原样在真实终端里运行，你随时可以接管。

companies.name: Klaimee
companies.originalOneLiner: Liability insurance for AI Agents. You deploy agents, we cover you.
companies.originalDescription: Klaimee is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind. Built for companies deploying agentic AI, self-serve from day one. The problem: AI agents are taking actions autonomously buying, emailing, modifying sensitive data. AB 316 already holds deployers liable. EU AI Act enforces in August. Cyber and E&O insurance are excluding AI claims. Companies shipping agents have zero coverage and no third-party proof their agent is safe. Enterprise legal asks "who pays if your agent breaks something?" and there's no good answer. We built the answer. Critical-category risk evaluation, certification, financial guarantee, liability insurance and the documentation enterprise procurement needs to sign off. Team: Ines (ex-General Manager at SafetyWing, grew insurance product from $5M to $60M revenue, 5 years launching insurance products from scratch and structuring a TokioMarine MGA into its own carrier) + Julien (AI software engineer + corporate strategy, enterprise compliance). We understand how insurance works, what enterprises require, and why startups can't wait 6 months for either.
companies.story: 这是给部署智能体的公司做责任保险的团队。一个风控或法务负责人每天会被业务部门追问，智能体自己下单、发邮件、改敏感数据，万一它闯了祸，到底谁来赔，传统的错误遗漏险和网络安全险又明确把这类理赔排除在外。Klaimee 把风险评级、认证、财务担保、责任保险和采购需要的文件打包成自助产品，让公司敢把智能体放到真实业务里跑。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，切入的正是监管开始收紧、而保险条款留下空白的时点。

companies.name: Ignition Benefits
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI-Native Benefits Brokerage
companies.originalDescription: Ignition is an AI-native employee benefits brokerage for companies with under 200 employees. Health insurance is one of the largest line items these companies carry, and employers absorb 15 to 40% rate increases year after year without ever seeing their own numbers. We have rebuilt the sales and back office to be AI-first. This market represents about $500B of market cap, and those businesses have not fundamentally changed in over 50 years. While scaling Plated, I wore every HR hat from doing payroll myself, to managing a PEO, to eventually hiring an employee benefits broker on our way to 1,500 employees. We wasted over $4M on benefits over 5 years, and I'm building Ignition to help companies under 200 employees avoid making my mistakes.
companies.story: 这是做员工福利经纪的公司，服务的是两百人以下的企业。假如你是一家小公司的运营或人事负责人，医疗保险是账上最大的一笔支出之一，每年费率涨一成半到四成，你只能照单全收，连自己公司的实际理赔数字都看不到。Ignition 把销售和后台重做成人工智能优先的流程，帮这类企业看清自己的数据、少走弯路。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队八人，正在招聘，创始人此前在把公司做到一千五百人的过程中亲手做过工资、人事和福利经纪，五年里在福利上花掉超过四百万美元，这段经历正是它想帮别人避开的坑。

companies.name: Perseus Defense
companies.originalOneLiner: America's Golden Dome for Drones
companies.originalDescription: Perseus Defense is building a mass-manufactured Counter UAS solution for the Department of Defense and Department of Homeland Security. Current solutions are one-to-one, too dangerous for use on U.S. soil, and orders of magntiude more expensive than the threats they defeat. Our self-guided missile platform is man-portable and multi-domain capable. It senses, engages, and eliminates threats with drastically reduced cost per engagement over existing kinetic solutions. Solving this critical national security problem requires understanding complex DoD needs along with actual rocket science including aerodynamics, guidance, navigation, control, and much more. Jason and Steve met at Penn State while they pursued their PhD and MS in aerospace engineering, respectively. Their past experiences designing space helicopters for NASA, making Boeing airliners land autonomously, controlling swarms of unmanned autonomous systems, teaching aerospace engineering at Stanford, winning multiple ONR and DOE engineering competitions, and founding an international drone competition makes them the perfect team to create transformative solutions protecting our service members. "If you build this, it will be mandatory equipment for every truck, boat, and convoy in the U.S. Military. We're talking thousands of units." - Former DoD Procurement Officer The White House just released Executive Order, "Unleashing American Drone Dominance" which adds billions of dollars, government support, and streamlined regulations to enable the development of our product. Traction: Jason and Steve used more than 100 end-user interviews across the DoD and DHS to shape the product to something of critical need to both boots on the ground and DoD purchasers. In 8 short weeks following a strict 2-week design-build-test cycle, the team has gone through 4 major guided missile iterations with over 30 live-fire flight tests. They were invited to Ft. Hood to present their platform to the 1st Cavalry Division, and also briefed the Pentagon and U.S. congressmen on current U.S. vulnerabilities to advanced drone technology. Perseus Defense is actively standing up cooperative research agreements with U.S. Army DEVCOM's Applied Research Laboratory, Aviation and Missile Center, Armaments Center, and High Performance Computing Modernization Program.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是反无人机防御，面向国防和国土安全场景。想象你是一位负责基地或关键设施防护的安保主管，天上飞来一群廉价无人机，现有拦截手段一次只能对付一个目标，价格还比威胁本身贵出几个数量级，而且在美国本土使用风险太大。Perseus Defense 做的是可单兵携带、多域适用的自导导弹平台，能感知、接战并摧毁目标，把每次交战的成本大幅压下来。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队三人，正在招聘，两位创始人在宾州州立大学分别攻读航空航天博士和硕士，做过为美国航天局设计太空直升机、让波音客机自动降落以及控制无人机集群等工作。

companies.name: Rasyn
companies.originalOneLiner: Making chemicals 100,000x faster
companies.originalDescription: We builds foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs. Designing a new formulation is essentially a search problem, because there are more possible mixtures than anyone could ever test, and none of them can be predicted in advance. As a result, bringing a single formulation to market today takes three to five years of trial and error in a lab. Our models predict how a mixture will behave far faster than the standard methods used today, which lets us design new formulations in weeks rather than years, at a fraction of the cost. To prove this, we used them to invent three chemicals that never existed before, including a PFAS-free coolant for datacenters, and we have since synthesized and patented all three. We are already working with some of the largest manufacturers to design formulations for them, and we are building our own lab to generate the data that will train our next models.
companies.story: 这是做化学基础模型的公司，方向是配方材料。如果你在一家化工或材料企业负责配方研发，你会知道数据中心冷却液、导热膏、油漆、胶水这些产品都不是单一化学品，而是十种左右成分的混合物，可能的组合比任何人能试的都多，也没法提前预测，一款配方上市往往要在实验室里试错三到五年。Rasyn 的模型能比现有方法快得多地预测混合物行为，把设计周期从数年压缩到数周，成本也低得多。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人，已经用模型造出三种此前不存在的化学品，其中包括不含全氟化合物的数据中心冷却液。

companies.name: Waddle Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: LLMs that control robots
companies.story: 这家公司做的是用大语言模型控制机器人。假如你是一位工厂或仓储的自动化负责人，机械臂和移动机器人换一个任务就要重新写一遍控制逻辑，产线一变，工程师就得从头调，响应速度跟不上业务。Waddle Labs 想让语言模型直接承担控制这一层，让人用自然语言下达任务，机器人自己完成动作。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，方向落在生成式人工智能和机器人自动化的交叉点上，这个位置目前真正跑通产品的团队并不多。

companies.name: IMPACT Drones
companies.originalOneLiner: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
companies.originalDescription: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles, hardware, reloads and monitoring included: Air Defense as a Service. 180M+ USD in signed letters of intent.
companies.story: 这是给民用基础设施提供空中防御服务的公司。想象你是一座数据中心或机场的设施负责人，周围空域偶尔出现来路不明的无人机，传统拦截弹一发上百万美元，而对面那架可能只值三万美元，你根本打不起，也不可能在场地常驻一支操作班组。IMPACT 把自主拦截无人机装进密封箱体，直接放在被保护的地点，传感器发现目标后，拦截机顶开易碎盖升空，靠机载视觉在卫星导航被干扰时仍然锁定并撞击目标。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，站点按订阅方式获得保护，硬件、补弹和监控都包含在内，目前已签下超过一亿八千万美元的意向书。

companies.name: Novaflow
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI data analyst for biology labs
companies.originalDescription: Novaflow is the AI data analyst for biology labs. -- Bioinformatics data analysis is a time-consuming and expensive process for scientists. With Novaflow, life scientists can upload experimental data, ask questions in plain English, and get instant, publication-ready plots, giving them results in minutes instead of months. Researchers at leading institutions like UCSF, Mount Sinai, UC Berkeley, and Harvard are already using Novaflow in their labs.
companies.story: 这是给生物实验室做人工智能数据分析的公司。如果你是一位生命科学研究者，做完一轮实验拿到测序数据，接下来往往要花几个月做生信分析，画图、调流程、反复确认，真正用来思考生物学问题的时间被挤得所剩无几。Novaflow 让研究者直接上传实验数据，用日常语言提问，几分钟内拿到可直接用于发表的图表，而不是等上几个月。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，加州大学旧金山分校、西奈山、加州大学伯克利分校和哈佛等机构的研究者已经在实验室里使用它。

readings.title: The Download: AI’s trillion-dollar gamble and OpenAI’s biology data bid
readings.story: 每隔一段时间，行业里就会冒出一个听起来大到不真实的数字，然后所有人开始追问：这笔钱到底会落在哪里。做投资、做产品、甚至只是关心自己所在行业的人，都会在某个时刻被这类问题绕进去，因为它牵动的不是某一家公司的命运，而是整条链条上谁先受益、谁先承压。这篇值得读的地方在于，它没有停在数字本身，而是把注意力放到钱流向哪里、又由谁来承接。读的时候可以留意作者是怎么把一个大而模糊的命题拆成几个可以追问的环节，以及他在哪些地方给出了判断，哪些地方留了余地。

readings.title: Muse review: The personal AI agent that gets consumer UX right
readings.story: 做产品的人大概都有过这种体验：功能明明做出来了，用户却不知道怎么用，或者用了一次就再也不回来。问题往往不在能力本身，而在第一眼看到的东西有没有说清楚它能干什么。这篇讲的是一款面向普通人的 人工智能 助手，它被拿出来讨论，恰恰是因为在这一点上做对了。读的时候不妨带着自己的产品去看：作者是怎么判断哪些交互细节真正影响了用户的理解和信任，又是怎么区分“看起来聪明”和“用起来顺手”的。这类判断对做消费产品的人尤其有参考价值。

readings.title: The Boox Palma 3 gets stylus support and a sleek redesign
readings.story: 有些设备一开始只是小众玩物，后来慢慢变成一群人每天随身带的东西，电子墨水阅读器大概就是这一类。它不追求性能参数，而是解决一个很具体的问题：在不想被通知打断的时候，还能不能安静地看点东西。这条讨论出现在技术社区里，说明关注它的人不只是普通消费者，还有不少工程师和早期用户在琢磨它的取舍。读的时候可以看它这次改了什么、又保留了什么，以及社区里的人在争论哪些点：是手写笔的加入，还是外形和手感的变化，往往能看出这类产品真正的用户在意什么。

companies.name: Vector Legal
companies.originalOneLiner: A premier AI-native law firm & legal operating system for Startups.
companies.originalDescription: A modern solution for Startup legal. Vector combines premier lawyers/paralegals (averaging 10+ years of Big Law experience) + custom-built AI, so our clients get world class startup legal service at a fraction of Big Law rates. See our client testimonials - https://www.vectorlegal.com/testimonials. Services: fundraise & priced rounds | customer contracts | international flips | complex formations | grow your team | agentic data rooms | e-signatures | cap table management | legal health checks | mergers & acquisitions | co-founder separations | dissolutions.
companies.story: 这是做初创企业法律服务的公司。如果你是一家刚完成融资的初创公司创始人，今天正为一份投资条款清单发愁，既想快点签下来又怕漏掉关键条款，Vector Legal 就是为这种时刻准备的。它把平均十年以上大所经验的律师和律师助理与自研人工智能结合起来，处理融资和定价轮、客户合同、跨国架构调整、复杂设立、股权结构管理、法律健康检查、并购以及联合创始人分家等事务，让初创公司以远低于大所的价格拿到同等水准的服务。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘，客户评价也放在官网上。

companies.name: Promptless
companies.originalOneLiner: An AI teammate that automatically updates your customer-facing docs
companies.originalDescription: Docs are integral to a great customer experience, but managing them is a challenging, multi-team effort. The most successful companies recognize that fantastic docs drive adoption and bad ones cause customers to churn. Promptless is used by fast-growing startups and Fortune 500 enterprises alike to automatically update docs based on feature releases, support tickets, internal Slack conversations, and more. Promptless is designed to be flexible—it can integrate with any docs platform, be triggered automatically from many workflows, and can pull in context from any internal knowledge source. With Promptless, documentation becomes a strategic advantage for growth, not a bottleneck or a liability.
companies.story: 这是做客户文档自动更新的公司。想象你负责一家快速增长的软件公司的产品文档，每次功能上线、支持工单堆积、内部 Slack 讨论里冒出关键信息，你都要手动翻遍各处再把文档改一遍，稍慢一步客户就来投诉。Promptless 是一个自动帮你更新面向客户文档的智能体，它根据功能发布、支持工单、内部 Slack 对话等信号自动改动内容，能接入各种文档平台，也能从内部知识源拉取上下文。它来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队五人，正在招聘，既有快速增长的初创公司使用，也有财富五百强企业使用。

companies.name: Corvera
companies.originalOneLiner: The context layer for AI-native CPG brands
companies.originalDescription: Corvera (YC W26) is the context layer for AI-native CPG brands. We help brands unlock the full potential of AI by making their unified data legible to any AI tool via MCP. As of mid-March 2026, we scaled from $0 to $33k in MRR in 4 weeks, are serving 12 brands, and are growing 130% week-on-week. With Corvera in place, brands can enable anyone in their organization to: - Rapidly deploy AI agents via tools such as Claude and ChatGPT, - Build dashboards and apps using Cursor and Lovable, and - Automate workflows across the entire business, from category management to supply chain. All in a secure, audit-logged, and access-controlled environment, without the need for a team of data engineers or AI specialists, in a simple plug-and-play solution. We're founded by Chris (2x Founder; ex-CEO at Better Nature; Forbes 30U30), Dirk (ex-Google Data & AI Lead), and Matthew (ex-Head of Product at Rosemark; Princeton MEng in CS). To-date, we’ve raised $6.2M and are backed by YC, firstminute capital, 6 Degrees Capital, 20VC, Rebel Fund, Duke Capital Partners, and more. Our ICP are omnichannel retail-focused CPG brands at the $100M+ revenue inflection point. Our mission is bold: to enable the next generation of unicorn CPG brands to be run by teams of less than 10 people. Our vision is even bolder: to be the system of intelligence for the $5.4T global CPG industry. Visit www.corvera.ai to learn more!
companies.story: 这是做消费品品牌数据底层的公司。假如你是一家新兴消费品牌的运营负责人，公司数据散在电商后台、广告平台和表格里，你想让人工智能帮忙做品类管理或供应链自动化，却发现工具根本读不懂这些数据。Corvera 就是为这类品牌准备的情境层，它把品牌内部数据整理成任何人工智能工具都能读懂的形式，让员工可以快速部署智能体、用 Cursor 和 Lovable 搭看板和应用、把品类管理到供应链的流程自动化，而且整个过程有安全、审计日志和权限控制，不需要专门的数据工程团队。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队四人，输入提到它在四周内从零做到每月三万三千美元经常性收入，服务十二个品牌，每周环比增长百分之一百三十。

companies.name: Hemlock
companies.originalOneLiner: Force-sensing wristband for training robotic AI
companies.originalDescription: Every serious robotics lab is bottlenecked on the same thing: demonstration data. The field has converged on egocentric video and hand pose as the substrate, and both are now cheap to collect at scale. What neither of them contains is force. A video of someone picking up an egg and a video of someone picking up a rock are nearly identical in pixel space and nearly identical in joint angles. They differ almost entirely in a quantity nobody is recording. Policies trained without it learn geometry and inherit no sense of touch. Hemlock closes that gap at the source. Our device, the Bracelet, is a wrist-worn surface EMG band that reads the electrical activity of the forearm muscles that actually drive the hand, which means it recovers contraction force directly rather than inferring it from motion. This distinction is the whole thesis: force cannot be reconstructed downstream of kinematics, because a hand squeezing hard isometrically and a hand resting can occupy the identical pose. Muscle signal is the only non-invasive channel that separates them.
companies.story: 这是做机器人训练数据采集硬件的公司，具体来说是一只戴在手腕上的力传感手环。假如你在一家机器人实验室负责训练机械臂抓取模型，你手上已经有很多第一视角视频和手部姿态数据，可你发现模型学会的只是形状和角度，拿起鸡蛋和拿起石头在画面与关节角度上几乎一样，差别全在力度，而力度恰恰没人记录。Hemlock 的手环通过读取前臂肌肉的电活动，直接还原手部发力的大小，而不是事后从运动轨迹里猜。它值得关注的地方在于，这不是一个手机应用，而是把传感能力放进随身佩戴的设备里，从数据产生的源头补上触觉这一层。公司来自 YC 秋季批次，目前团队只有一人，正在招聘，方向属于硬科技与硬件。

companies.name: Zolvo
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Back-Office Automation for Commercial Lenders
companies.originalDescription: Commercial lenders manage billions in assets on legacy software and manual workflows, their systems live on people’s heads like its the 90s. Zolvo replaces the entire back office with AI: automated data ingestion, invoice reconciliation, collections outreach, and funder monitoring. Our clients go live in weeks and eliminate hours of daily manual work per operator, allowing teams to only handle exceptions. We're building the future of commercial lending.
companies.story: 这是做商业贷款后台自动化的公司。一个商业贷款机构的运营人员每天要处理成堆的发票、对账、催收和外部的资金方监控，系统老旧，很多流程还靠人脑记着，一天下来大半时间耗在重复劳动上。Zolvo 用人工智能替掉整个后台，自动完成数据录入、发票核对、催收触达和资金方监控，客户几周内就能上线，每个操作人员每天省下数小时手工工作，团队只需要处理例外情况。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，目前没有招聘，切入的是商业贷款这个资产规模巨大却长期依赖旧软件的领域。

companies.name: Arlo Industries
companies.originalOneLiner: Track drones and missiles without radars - Accurate, Passive, Scalable
companies.originalDescription: Arlo Industries is building a network of sensors that precisely tracks stealthy drones and aerial threats better than radars. This capability does not exist yet because traditional radars are built on past war doctrines designed to protect single, centralised assets. Modern warfare, however, demands wide-area, persistent coverage that is both passive and economically scalable. By utilising a mesh architecture, Arlo Industries unlocks unprecedented asymmetric economics. The network is fundamentally built to scale: the cost of adding sensors grows linearly, but the tracking accuracy increases exponentially, delivering highly resilient, persistent coverage for a fraction of the cost of legacy systems. Deo founded Arlo Industries after spending over 6 years in the Israeli defence ecosystem, where he lived through multiple conflicts and experienced the Iron Dome and other systems in action against ICBMs and the infamous Shahed drones. Learning exactly how these defence systems could be improved after a Shahed exploded close to his apartment, he built Arlo Industries around the core philosophy that conflict should be concise & precise. The people behind Arlo1 includes a PhD in drones and autonomy and military experts. Arlo Industries has actively showcased this technology directly to Ukrainian militaries on the frontlines, as well as to operators across Europe and the USA.
companies.story: 这是做无人机和导弹追踪传感网络的公司。如果你负责一片区域的低空防御，今天最头疼的是小型隐身无人机贴着地面飞过来，传统雷达要么看不见，要么成本高得没法铺满。Arlo Industries 用一张网状传感器网络来精确追踪这类空中威胁，不靠雷达，而是被动探测，覆盖范围广，可以持续工作。它的逻辑是传感器数量线性增加，追踪精度却指数上升，因此比传统系统便宜得多，也更能承受损失。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘，创始人此前在以色列防务领域待了六年多，亲历过多次冲突并见过铁穹等系统的实际运作。

companies.name: Dispatch
companies.originalOneLiner: Satellites for Manufacturing in Space
companies.originalDescription: Dispatch is building refurbishable reentry vehicles that host and return payloads for companies making ultra-high-value materials (semiconductors, biotech, and pharma) that can only be manufactured in space. Right now, these companies have no practical way to manufacture and get their products back to Earth. We solve this bottleneck. We just returned from the Mojave Desert testing our first full-scale reentry heat shield designed to protect the satellite as it returns from space at Mach 20+, built in an apartment for 100x cheaper than competitors. To test, we held it behind a rocket engine to simulate the forces of atmospheric reentry. IT WORKED! Watch here - https://youtu.be/dhlQmnIoptg To scale, we anchor permanent infrastructure in orbit - building high power Autonomous Space Stations designed from day one for "lights-out" manufacturing serviced by the reentry vehicles.
companies.story: 这是做太空制造往返运输的公司。假设你在一家半导体或生物医药企业负责工艺，你很清楚有些材料只有在微重力环境下才能造出来，可造完怎么安全运回地球，一直没有可行的办法。Dispatch 造的是可翻新的再入飞行器，用来搭载并带回这些高价值载荷，同时还在轨道上布置为无人化制造设计的高功率自主空间站。团队刚从莫哈韦沙漠回来，测试了首个全尺寸再入隔热罩，在公寓里造出来，成本比同行低一百倍，测试方式是把隔热罩放在火箭发动机后面模拟再入大气层的受力，结果成功了。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘。

companies.name: RonanRx Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Full Stack Pharmaceutical Company for Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
companies.originalDescription: RonanRX is a full-stack pharmaceutical company, starting with personalized peptides and GLP-1s. In our first 10 weeks, we went from having no pharmacy to being licensed in 33 states. Since launch, we’ve grown 50% week over week. We manufacture the medications ourselves, sell directly to patients, and eliminate the layers of middlemen that make prescription drugs more expensive. What makes this possible is AI. Traditional pharmaceutical companies are built to manufacture one drug for millions of people. RonanRX is purpose-built to personalize treatment for each patient: different biology, different response, different dose. Patients come directly to RonanRX or through doctors using our platform. Every patient completes our medical intake, meets with a licensed doctor through our telehealth platform, and receives a personalized prescription when appropriate. From there, we manufacture the medication ourselves and deliver it directly to the patient. Labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and other health data feed back into the platform so doctors can continuously refine treatment over time. Before AI, doing this for every patient at scale was impossible. We didn't invent the demand we are seeing. 80 Million people are on a GLP-1 and millions more are using Peptides. We're building a better way to manufacture, personalize, prescribe, and deliver them. Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised more than $100M, built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business, and spent years developing peptide therapeutics at companies including Eli Lilly and AbbVie. We’re just getting started with peptides and GLP-1s. Next comes hormone therapy and the rest of personalized medicine.
companies.story: 这是做个性化肽类和减重药物的全栈制药公司。如果你是一位想用这类药物但标准剂量总不对路的患者，今天可能正为找不到合适的方案而反复换药。RonanRx 让患者直接完成医疗问诊，通过远程医疗平台与持牌医生会面，在合适的情况下拿到个性化处方，药物由公司自己生产，直接卖给患者，省掉层层中间商。它用人工智能支撑按人定制的生产逻辑，而不是像传统药企那样一款药卖给几百万人。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队五人，输入提到它在最初十周从没有药房做到在三十三个州获得执照，上线后每周环比增长百分之五十。

companies.name: Cova
companies.originalOneLiner: Financial infrastructure for family caregiving
companies.originalDescription: Cova is an AI-native home care agency, licensed in Michigan. We serve Medicaid, LTCI, and private-pay patients; we pay caregivers the highest base rate in the state; and we help unpaid family caregivers get paid through programs they didn't know they qualified for. Our entire operation runs on AI agents, which means less overhead and more value passed directly to the people doing the real work.
companies.story: 这是做家庭照护财务基础设施的公司。假如你是一位在家照顾年迈父母的子女，今天正为请护工的费用发愁，却不知道自己可能符合某些补贴项目的条件。Cova 是一家在密歇根州获得执照的人工智能原生居家护理机构，服务医疗补助、长期护理保险和自费患者，给护理员开出全州最高的基础时薪，还帮无偿的家庭照护者申请他们原本不知道自己有资格拿到的项目款项。整家公司由智能体运转，开销更低，省下的价值直接给到真正干活的人。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，目前没有招聘。

companies.name: Hedge
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-Native insurance company
companies.originalDescription: Hedge is an AI-Native specialty insurance company. We help insurance brokers find faster, cheaper, and better coverage for their customers.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能原生保险的公司。一个保险经纪人每天要替客户在多家承保方之间比价，今天遇到一个特殊风险的单子，传统渠道要么报价慢，要么干脆不接。Hedge 是一家专注特殊风险的人工智能原生保险公司，帮经纪人更快、更便宜、更合适地为客户找到保障。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，切的是保险这个长期依赖人工核保和纸质流程的领域，用人工智能把报价和承保环节压缩下来。

readings.title: A Vinyl Bar in Shibuya is a startup offering fun music apps without any AI prompting
readings.story: 现在做音乐 App 的人常被一个问题困住：要不要加 人工智能 生成，不加会不会显得落后。可真实场景里，很多人打开音乐软件只是想随便点几下，听点好玩的东西，并不想先写一段提示词。这篇讲的是东京涩谷一家黑胶酒吧做起的创业公司，偏偏选择不做 人工智能 提示这条路。值得读，是因为它把“不用最新技术也能做出有趣产品”当成正经生意来试。读的时候可以留意作者怎么描述用户玩音乐的具体时刻，以及团队在功能取舍上把什么留了下来、把什么砍掉了。

readings.title: The Download: AI’s real extinction threat and age-reversal tech for eyes
readings.story: 每当有人讨论 人工智能 会不会毁灭人类，话题很容易滑向科幻式的想象，反而看不清眼前真正该担心什么。普通读者刷到这类标题时，常常分不清哪些是危言耸听，哪些是研究者认真在算的账。这篇来自 MIT Technology Review 的每日简报，把 人工智能 的灭绝风险和一项针对眼睛的逆龄技术放在一起讲。值得读，是因为它帮你把两个看似无关的方向摆在同一张桌上看。读的时候注意作者如何区分不同层级的风险，以及他判断一项技术离实用还有多远时，看的是哪些证据。

readings.title: Show HN: ChaosTree – A zero-dependency Java tree library (AVL,RBT,B-Tree,B+Tree)
readings.story: 写 Java 的人大概都有过这种时刻：想找个数据结构库，结果拉进来一堆依赖，最后为了一个平衡树背上了整个生态。Hacker News 上这类 Show HN 帖子，往往就是某个工程师受够了现状，自己动手写了一个。这条讲的是 ChaosTree，一个零依赖的 Java 树库，涵盖 AVL、红黑树、B 树和 B+ 树。值得读，是因为它让人看到一个人如何把日常的不方便变成一个小项目。读的时候可以看作者怎么划定范围，为什么选这几种树，以及社区在评论里追问的是性能、接口还是维护意愿。

companies.name: Dalus
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-Powered Hardware System Design Software
companies.originalDescription: Dalus is an AI-powered systems engineering software to model/validate complex systems for aerospace/defense/robotics and other mission-critical industries. With Dalus, engineers can seamlessly trace requirements, perform analyses, and update information in real-time. This ensures that every team member stays aligned and informed, reducing inefficiencies and enabling faster iterations. With AI at our core, users can analyze hundreds of pages of existing engineering documentation and requirements to generate or retrieve information about the system model they are building in Dalus. We started working together on Dalus in spring 2024 after Eliot quit his job at Aerojet Rocketdyne (L3Harris) where he worked as a test/systems engineer. He experienced first-hand how silos and poor communication reduced the productivity and efficiencies in the teams he worked at. We love working with companies tackling complex engineering systems, whether they be startups just getting their feet wet or large organizations like Israel Aerospace Industries (Our design partner and biggest aerospace/defense company from Israel) Read why we started Dalus: https://dalus.io/articles/why-dalus
companies.story: 这是做复杂硬件系统设计软件的公司，服务航空航天、国防和机器人等任务关键行业。假如你是一名航天系统的工程负责人，今天正为一枚新火箭梳理几百页需求文档，改动一处参数就要翻遍旧文件，团队之间信息还对不上。Dalus 让人工智能读取这些工程文档，帮工程师追踪需求、做分析并实时更新系统模型，减少重复沟通和返工。它来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队只有三人，目前正在招聘，适合关注工程软件和任务关键行业的人留意。

companies.name: Haladir
companies.originalOneLiner: Operational Superintelligence for Global Logistics
companies.originalDescription: Haladir builds advanced AI systems for logistics. We sit on top of your WMS, TMS and ERP, turning their data into decisions across supply chain planning and execution: solver-grade optimization that decides what should happen, and AI agents that run the workflows. Today's AI brought intelligence. The next frontier is judgement.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是全球物流的运营决策层。想象你是一家跨国制造企业的供应链主管，仓库、运输和企业管理系统里数据齐全，可到底该把哪批货调去哪个仓、遇到港口延误怎么改计划，还是靠人拍脑袋。Haladir 把系统架在仓储、运输和企业管理系统之上，一边用求解器级别的优化决定该发生什么，一边用智能体跑执行流程。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，方向覆盖人工智能、物流和供应链运营。

companies.name: Mastra
companies.originalOneLiner: The Javascript framework for building AI agents, from the Gatsby devs
companies.originalDescription: Mastra is the easiest way to build a production AI application, built by the team that brought you Gatsby. We provide a complete set of AI primitives: workflows for complex operations, agents for autonomous decisions, RAG for knowledge integration, and evals for quality & accuracy. Mastra is open-source, modular, and built in Typescript for product developers. You can deploy Mastra on any cloud, and it gives you a straightforward syntax to solve the hardest problems building with AI: human-in-the-loop workflows, agent memory and tool selection, and output quality.
companies.story: 这是给开发者做人工智能应用框架的公司。如果你是一名产品工程师，想给自家应用加一个能自主行动的智能体，往往要先拼好几套工具，还要自己处理记忆、工具调用和输出质量。Mastra 提供工作流、智能体、知识检索和评估等一整套基础模块，用 TypeScript 写成，开源且模块化，可以部署在任何云上。它出自做过 Gatsby 的团队，来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队约三十人，适合正在把人工智能功能做进产品的开发者关注。

companies.name: One Robot
companies.originalOneLiner: World models for robot evals and training.
companies.originalDescription: One Robot builds simulation environments that are realistic to see and realistic to interact with, so robotics teams can train and evaluate robot policies without being bottlenecked by robot time. Today, improving a VLA often means more real-world hours: setting up the scene, running trials, resetting, and repeating. This loop is slow, expensive, and hard to scale. For example, material handling and manufacturing assembly tasks, models need far more training and evaluation data than teams can collect in the real world. We use task-specific data to build world model-based simulation environments for hard manipulation tasks (for example, textiles and box folding). These environments help teams run more training and evals, find failure modes faster, and accelerate iteration on action policies with less dependence on real-world data collection and robot availability.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是机器人训练和评测用的世界模型仿真环境。假设你是一个机器人团队的工程负责人，想让机械臂学会叠衣服或折纸箱，可每试一次都要搭场景、跑实验、复位再重来，真机时间根本不够用。One Robot 用任务数据构建既看得真实又能交互的仿真环境，让团队在里面多跑训练和评测，更快找到失败模式，减少对真机和实采数据的依赖。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，做机器人学习的人可以留意。

companies.name: Torus
companies.originalOneLiner: Legora for physical engineering firms
companies.originalDescription: Torus lets engineering firms and project owners build infrastructure 10x faster to reindustrialize America and the West. We're working with multiple Fortune 500 companies to build critical infrastructure including data centers and critical energy installations.
companies.story: 这家公司服务的是实体工程公司的基础设施建设。假如你负责一家工程公司的项目交付，手上同时压着数据中心和能源装置的图纸、审批和多方协作，进度一拖就是几个月。Torus 想帮工程公司和项目业主把建设速度提高一个量级，用于再工业化。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队六人，正在招聘，并且正在和多家财富五百强公司合作建设数据中心和关键能源设施，这是它值得关注的真实信号。

companies.name: Twolabs
companies.originalOneLiner: Humanoid robot platform for builders.
companies.originalDescription: We build modular humanoid robots and the software platform that allows anyone to train, deploy, and scale robots for real-world tasks. Today, teaching a robot a new skill requires robotics engineers, machine learning engineers, training infrastructure, and significant compute resources. We reduce that process to: Record → Upload → Train → Deploy. Our robots are modular and configurable, with interchangeable end effectors, configurable sensors, and multiple deployment configurations. We believe current humanoid embodiments are often overfit for specific use cases, so we're building a platform that adapts to different environments and applications. Long term, we want robotics to be as accessible as software development. Our goal is to become the default platform for training and deploying autonomous robots.
companies.story: 这是做人形机器人平台的公司，硬件和软件一起做。想象你是一个想用机器人干实际任务的开发者，过去教机器人一项新技能，要凑齐机器人工程师、机器学习工程师、训练设施和大量算力。Twolabs 把流程压成录制、上传、训练、部署四步，机器人本体模块化，末端执行器可换，传感器可配置，部署方式也多样。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人。这不是手机应用，而是把训练和部署能力放进可配置的机器人身体和随身场景里。

companies.name: Axis
companies.originalOneLiner: An AI Copilot for Trading Desks
companies.originalDescription: Axis is building an AI Native Trading System, allowing a trader to deploy models that monitor and analyze relevant markets and strategies. We've chosen commodities as our first market. Commodities make up a third of global goods exports, and physical commodities traders decide the movement and storage of metals, agricultural products, and energy across the globe. They trade in public markets and bilateral OTC agreements. Engaging in these markets is complexing, covering derivatives positioning, refinery data, storage inventory, import/exports, geopolitical events and more. Axis is building an AI driven analytical layer for these markets.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是交易台的智能分析工具。如果你是一名大宗商品交易员，每天早上要盯衍生品持仓、炼厂数据、库存、进出口和地缘事件，信息散在各处，判断全靠自己拼。Axis 在做一套人工智能原生的交易系统，让交易员部署模型去监控和分析相关市场与策略，先从大宗商品入手，因为这类实物商品占全球货物出口的三分之一。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人，做的是把分散信息变成分析层这件事。

companies.name: Amera
companies.originalOneLiner: Automating claims processing workflows for health insurance payers.
companies.originalDescription: Amera automates claims processing for health insurance payers. We turn messy claim inputs (PDFs, bills, receipts, EDI and non-standard submissions) into structured data that plugs into existing systems. This cuts manual entry and exception handling, speeding up operations and reducing cost. We are already working with payers / plan administrators representing ~100k members, giving them access to more affordable care options.
companies.story: 这是做医疗保险理赔流程自动化的公司。想象你是一名健康保险支付方的理赔运营负责人，每天收到成堆的理赔材料，有 PDF、账单、收据，也有电子数据交换格式和非标准提交，人工录入和异常处理吃掉大量时间。Amera 把这些杂乱输入转成结构化数据，接进现有系统，减少手工录入和例外处理，加快处理速度并降低成本。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队十二人，已经在服务代表约十万名会员的支付方和计划管理者，这是值得关注的实际进展。

companies.name: Vestris
companies.originalOneLiner: AI native platform for real estate closings
companies.originalDescription: Vestris automates title processing end-to-end, from contract to close, so title shops can close more deals with fewer processors. Title insurance has famously high margins, but slow, manual processing is a constant pain — especially in today's bleeding housing market.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是房地产过户流程的自动化。假如你是一家产权公司的处理主管，手上每笔交易都要从合同一路跟到交割，文件多、环节碎，处理员不够用，房子又不好卖，压力全压在效率上。Vestris 想用人工智能原生平台把产权处理从头到尾自动化，让产权公司用更少的人完成更多交易。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人。产权保险利润高但流程慢而手工，这个场景本身就说明了它为什么值得看。

companies.name: Gutgutgoose
companies.originalOneLiner: We sequence your gut and build the probiotics it’s missing
companies.originalDescription: Most data companies pay for their data. Ours pays for itself. Customers send us a stool sample. We sequence it, build a metabolic model of that gut, and simulate whether each probiotic strain has an open niche it can colonize. We formulate the best candidates, then re-sequence 90 days later to see what actually took hold and what changed. Each cycle gives us the baseline gut, the intervention, and the outcome. At scale, the endgame is models that predict chronic disease years before symptoms.
companies.story: 这是做肠道测序和个性化益生菌的消费健康公司。如果你长期肠胃不舒服，试过很多益生菌却不知道哪一种真能在自己肠道里存活，通常只能凭感觉买。Gutgutgoose 让用户寄一份粪便样本，做测序并建立代谢模型，模拟每种菌株有没有空位可以定植，再配出候选产品，九十天后重新测序看实际效果。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人。每一轮都留下基线、干预和结果，长期目标是预测慢性病。

readings.title: Show HN: Analyst Index – analysts who make money telling you good stock calls
